description:
7AI is seeking a high-velocity, revenue-driven Director, Public Sector Alliances to define, build, and scale our partner ecosystem across U.S. Federal, State and Local Government, and Education (SLED). 7AI runs a 100% partner-led go-to-market, and public sector is no exception: you will own the distribution, contract vehicle, reseller, and federal systems integrator strategy that allows government customers to buy and deploy 7AI, and build a predictable, ecosystem-led growth engine for the public sector.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned public sector channel leader who understands how government buys—from distribution and contract vehicles to prime contractors and the FedRAMP ecosystem—and who excels at turning that network into an exponential revenue multiplier. You will be responsible for setting the public sector alliance vision, operationalizing our distribution and contract vehicle strategy, recruiting and activating public sector resellers and federal systems integrators, accelerating co-sell revenue, and embedding 7AI into the core go-to-market strategies of our public sector partners. If you are a strategic leader who views partnerships through the lens of pipeline generation, ARR impact, and long-term market dominance, this role is for you.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the Public Sector Ecosystem Revenue Strategy: Set, drive, track, and exceed Federal and SLED partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and ARR targets, owning the full P&L impact of the public sector alliance motion.

  • Define the Public Sector Alliance Vision: Develop and execute a comprehensive public sector partner strategy, including segmentation, tiering, and investment prioritization across Public Sector Distributors, Contract Vehicle Holders, Resellers, Federal Systems Integrators and Prime Contractors, MSSPs, and Cloud Partners.

  • Operationalize Distribution & Contract Vehicles: Own the relationship and joint business plan with 7AI's public sector distributor, and drive the strategy for cooperative purchasing and government contract vehicles (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, GSA, SEWP, state and local contracts) so that every public sector customer has a clear, compliant path to purchase.

  • Build the Federal SI & Prime Contractor Channel: Recruit, enable, and co-sell with federal systems integrators and prime contractors serving defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies, including structuring multi-tier deal flow through distribution and designing deal structures that fit prime contract requirements.

  • Accelerate Co-Sell Orchestration: Architect and lead high-velocity co-sell motions between 7AI's public sector sellers and key partners to unlock net-new agencies and institutions and compress public sector sales cycles, including navigating procurement, budget cycles, and contract terms such as non-appropriation clauses.

  • Scale Partner Activation: Transform partnerships from transactional agreements into scalable, repeatable revenue channels through structured account-mapping, joint business planning, partner certification, and executive-level pipeline reviews.

  • Compliance & Authorization Alignment: Partner with Product, Security, and Legal to align partner engagement with 7AI's FedRAMP authorization path and other public sector compliance requirements (e.g., StateRAMP, CJIS, CMMC), ensuring partners can confidently position and deliver 7AI to government customers.

  • Cross-Functional Revenue Alignment: Partner closely with 7AI's Executive, Marketing, Product, Legal, and Sales leadership to build compelling, repeatable joint value propositions and public sector-specific enablement that incentivize partners to lead with 7AI.

  • Executive Relationship Ownership: Cultivate and own senior executive relationships across the public sector partner ecosystem, positioning 7AI as a strategic priority within partners' government GTM plans.

  • Internal & External Evangelism: Act as the strategic advocate for public sector partners inside 7AI, injecting "partner-first" DNA into our public sector sales culture, while serving as the primary champion of 7AI's value within the government partner community, at public sector industry events, and with partner marketing programs.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven Revenue Leadership: 8–12+ years of high-tech business development, channel, or alliances experience with a significant focus on U.S. public sector, with a documented history of hitting or exceeding multi-million dollar partner-sourced targets across Federal and/or SLED.

  • Deep Public Sector Network: Established, high-yield relationships already in place with public sector distributors, contract vehicle holders, government-focused resellers, and federal systems integrators and prime contractors that can be leveraged on day one.

  • Government Procurement Fluency: Working knowledge of how Federal and SLED customers buy, including distribution models, cooperative purchasing and contract vehicles, FAR/DFARS fundamentals, fiscal year and budget cycles, and the FedRAMP/StateRAMP authorization landscape.

  • Scale-First Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build structured partnership frameworks and lead a function that shifts business from traditional 1-to-1 sales toward a highly scalable, 1-to-many ecosystem model.

  • Alliances Strategy Mastery: Strong command of security operations, MDR/MSSP, SI, distribution, and cloud partner business models, with the strategic and tactical know-how to align their financial incentives with 7AI's growth in the public sector.

  • High Execution Velocity: A self-starting leader with a "strong motor" who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and drives results with minimal oversight, including building the public sector motion ahead of a dedicated federal sales team.

  • Strategic & Operational Acumen: Excellent analytical and strategic skills to formulate a public sector partnership vision, backed by the operational discipline and leadership to execute it at scale.

  • Location & Eligibility: Based in the Washington, D.C. metro area preferred, with the ability to travel across the United States. U.S. citizenship required; an active or previously held security clearance is a plus.

  • Core Values: Impeccable honesty, high integrity, sound business judgment, and a BA/BS degree (advanced degree a plus).
